description: Returns a heuristic high/medium/low address risk tier, named flags, ETH balance, holdings of 4 major tokens (USDC, WETH, cbBTC, DAI), and the Base EVM account nonce. Per-token risk is unknown because token contracts are not audited here. For EOAs the nonce counts outgoing transactions only, not full history. Address type is reported separately and does not affect the balance/nonce-based risk tier. Use to screen an address before paying it. Costs $0.02 in USDC on Base per successful call, paid with x402.
name: wallet-audit
